name: Planet Labs (PlanetScope + SkySat)
description: Daily-revisit Earth imaging from two fleets — ~150 PlanetScope 3U CubeSats (3-5 m resolution global daily imagery) and ~21 SkySats (50 cm tasked high-resolution). All at ~475 km sun-synchronous orbit. The 'Doves' philosophy was 'launch hundreds of cheap small satellites, accept a few failures, get every patch of land imaged every day' — and it works. Planet's image archive is consulted by NGOs, governments, and journalists.
